Welcome to Danycase Local Store

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------





Feels Like Writing On Paper
Smoothly and comfortable writing.




Paper-like film for Redmi Pad 10.61/SE 11
Restore the beauty of paper and draw the world you like.




Flexible Resin,No Nib Damage
Highly flexible resin with increased paper
damping for better nib protection.




Upgraded PET Material, New Paper Like Technology Only to simulate the real paper texture.
Reinforced Hard Surface Layer        
 Imported Optical PET Layer
Polymer Resin Layer                           
Plasma Frosted Layer





Restore the true color of the screen
Imported optical PET material,after adjusting the light transmittance,restore clear vision.




Full Screen Coverage Edge
Imported materials to prevent scratches.




Anti-scratch
No more worrying about damaging the screen when carrying multiple items.





Sticking Film Steps

You can refer to the steps in the product video.
1.Alcohol wipes to wipe the screen
2.Dry wipe screen
3.Dust removal sticker to remove dust from the screen
4.Tear off the label 1, align the film with the iPad screen, and use a scraper to scrape the air bubbles while sticking
5.After sticking, tear off the label 2


▶Packing list

1.Screen Protector*1
2.Sticking Film Tools
